games.name: QUICKDRAW: LEGACY
games.desc:
READ THE DESCRIPTION BEFORE PLAYING.

Bullet comes out of the barrel, there's no fixed reticle (like a crosshair). You can shoot through walls, depends on the material & thickness. Movement sways the arms & torso, causing the "fire spread" (there's NO RANDOM spread).

Scroll (UP/DOWN) or 1/2 - pick items from inventory
Q (PRESS) - equip/unequip Q (HOLD) - quickdraw state
Q + LMB (HOLD) - quickdraw
LMB (GUN EQUIPPED) (HOLD) - fire
RMB (GUN EQUIPPED) (HOLD) - focus
R (GUN EQUIPPED) (IN QUICKDRAW STATE) - switch to regular mode
R (GUN EQUIPPED) (PRESS/HOLD) - single/full reload
LEFT SHIFT (HOLD) - slow walk
LEFT CONTROL (HOLD) - crouch
RETURN - Popup on bottom left on death to go back to main menu.

LMB/RMB = R2/L2
Scroll = DPAD
Q = ButtonA
R = ButtonY
Z = ButtonX
Left Shift = ButtonL1
Left Control = ButtonR1

Mobile support exists, and you can rebind/change your layout in settings.
